bank_mission: Long-term memory of Rafael, the owner of this home lab: who he is, the people in his life, his preferences, habits, plans and decisions.
bank_retain_mission: Extract only lasting facts that the user (Rafael) states or confirms about himself, the people in his life, his preferences, habits and decisions: facts that help the assistant do his tasks better. Do NOT extract: tasks, to-dos, events, reminders, appointments or deadlines (they live in Nextcloud and the other self-hosted apps); anything the assistant said or claimed; the current state of tasks, to-dos, calendars, money, servers or anything else that changes (open, overdue, done, scheduled, up or down); one-off requests and commands; text that does not concern the user (stories, articles, quotes, read-aloud passages, other people's conversations); and garbled, nonsensical or mixed-language speech-recognition text. When in doubt, extract nothing.
